description: This file declares the API for the UDP Echo Server object in the Broadband Home Manager Model. It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the UDP Echo server object, which are intended to be used by other components in the system.

methods.name: BbhmCreateUDPEchoServer
methods.description: Creates an instance of the UDP Echo Server object.

methods.name: BbhmUdpechoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the UDP Echo object.

methods.name: BbhmUdpechoRemove
methods.description: Removes an instance of the UDP Echo object.

methods.name: BbhmUdpechoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the necessary objects for the UDP Echo server.

methods.name: BbhmUdpechoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the UDP Echo server object.
